Adult autonomy in book selection should be protected without state interference.
The existence of censorship threats undermines the value of free access to literature.
Political action at the federal level (e.g., through Congress) is necessary to safeguard civil liberties related to reading.
Cultural diversity contributes positively to societal progress and national identity.
There is a moral imperative to defend intellectual freedom as a core democratic value.
The speaker identifies with the values of inclusivity and pluralism in American society.
Public discourse on book access involves both personal and civic responsibility.
